intro: If you want to work on that with us, here is where to start.

paths.title: Undergraduate students
paths.text: Research assistant roles come up now and then. Most are 10 hours a week, paid or with research credit.

paths.title: Graduate students
paths.text: Paid research or teaching assistant roles can open for MSc and PhD students. They can cover part of tuition. US students can also apply for the NSF GRFP.

paths.title: Postdocs
paths.text: Two paths. I have some funding for a postdoc, or I can help you write a fellowship proposal, such as the NSF PRFB.

steps: Send a short note with your CV and what you would like to work on to cromanpa@arizona.edu.
We set up a call to talk about ideas and fit.
We look for a position, or a fellowship proposal we can write together.
